n1.speaker: npc_wren
n1.text: They say the High Chancellor's chair has been empty since before the east wing. The Lord Provost just signs 'on behalf of'.

n2.speaker: npc_wren
n2.text: On behalf of whom, nobody likes to ask.

n3.speaker: npc_wren
n3.text: And the Dominion's sent a demon over. Demon Second Class, Debt Recovery. Lovely manners. Takes notes on everyone.
